title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.47: Practice, Experience and One-Up now print 0 base damage and read 1, which comes from the Tuned they start each combat with - they were printing 1 and reading 2. The Compendium also previews Tuned cards the same way every other screen does; it used to show the printed number while a card reward showed the number you actually get.
